title: UAS activity over Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: Med flight at patteron Tower use Extreme Caution for heavy uas uh movement on the base

plain: In 2024, the control tower at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio warned a medical flight about heavy drone or unidentified aircraft traffic over the base. Michels plays the tower audio himself: "Med flight at Patterson Tower use extreme caution for heavy UAS movement on the base," UAS meaning unmanned aircraft systems. He raises it in a conversation about UFOs showing up at military and nuclear sites, as a sign this is still happening now.
